# TestOps MCP

> MCP server that connects Claude to Allure TestOps — launch tests, track results, manage test cases, and run bulk operations from a single conversation.

## Overview

TestOps MCP is a production-grade Go server implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP, protocol version 2025-11-25). It exposes **117 curated tools** plus a dynamic fallback covering **600+ Allure TestOps API endpoints** via an OpenAPI spec index, **2 prompt templates**, and **4 resources** (including 3 interactive widget resources). Supports two transports: **stdio** (Claude Desktop, single-user) and **HTTP + SSE** (shared team server, multi-user with per-session token isolation). Async tasks auto-expire after 1 hour; finished-task list is pruned every 5 minutes.

- Module: `github.com/MimoJanra/TestOpsMCP`
- Language: Go 1.27+
- License: Apache 2.0

## Key Packages

| Package | Role |
|---------|------|
| `cmd/server` | Entry point; `--http` flag selects transport |
| `internal/mcp` | JSON-RPC 2.0 dispatcher, SSE sessions, heartbeat |
| `internal/tools` | Tool registry, 117 tools, OpenAPI search/execute |
| `internal/adapters/allure` | HTTP client for Allure TestOps API, JWT caching |
| `internal/config` | Env-var configuration loader |
| `internal/core` | Structured JSON logger (slog-backed) |
| `internal/session` | Context-based session ID, user, elicitation, sampling propagation |
| `internal/audit` | Daily JSONL audit log with configurable retention |
| `internal/tasks` | Async task store (working/succeeded/failed/cancelled lifecycle) |

## Tool Groups (117 total)

- **Universal** (3): `configure_allure_token`, `search_testops_operations`, `execute_testops_operation`
- **Launches** (14): `run_allure_launch`, `get_launch_status`, `get_launch_report`, `list_launches`, `get_launch_details`, `close_launch`, `reopen_launch`, `copy_launch`, `merge_launches`, `get_launch_environment`, `add_test_cases_to_launch`, `add_test_plan_to_launch`, `remove_test_cases_from_launch`, `get_launch_defects`
- **Test Results** (6): `list_test_results`, `get_test_result`, `assign_test_result`, `mute_test_result`, `resolve_test_result`, `unmute_test_result`
- **Test Cases — Core** (11): `list_test_cases`, `get_test_case`, `create_test_case`, `update_test_case`, `delete_test_case`, `clone_test_case`, `restore_test_case`, `run_test_case`, `search_test_cases`, `suggest_test_cases`, `validate_test_case_query`
- **Test Cases — Steps** (8): `create_test_case_step`, `update_test_case_step`, `delete_test_case_step`, `move_test_case_step`, `copy_test_case_step`, `delete_test_case_scenario`, `get_test_case_scenario_from_run`, `detach_test_case_automation`
- **Test Cases — Metadata** (15): `get_test_case_tags`, `set_test_case_tags`, `create_test_tag`, `get_test_case_issues`, `set_test_case_issues`, `get_test_case_examples`, `set_test_case_examples`, `get_test_case_custom_fields`, `update_test_case_custom_fields`, `list_custom_field_values`, `get_test_case_keys`, `set_test_case_keys`, `get_test_case_relations`, `set_test_case_relations`, `get_test_case_workflow`
- **Test Cases — Members & Links** (6): `get_test_case_members`, `add_test_case_members`, `remove_test_case_members`, `get_test_case_external_links`, `add_test_case_external_link`, `delete_test_case_external_link`
- **Test Cases — Defects** (3): `get_test_case_defects`, `add_test_case_defect`, `remove_test_case_defect`
- **Test Cases — Versions & Attachments** (7): `list_test_case_versions`, `create_test_case_version`, `restore_test_case_version`, `get_test_case_version_data`, `delete_test_case_version`, `get_test_case_attachments`, `delete_test_case_attachment`
- **Test Cases — Audit & State** (4): `get_test_case_audit`, `get_test_case_history`, `list_deleted_test_cases`, `list_muted_test_cases`
- **Test Cases — Folder Tree** (4): `browse_test_case_tree`, `get_test_case_tree_folders`, `move_test_cases_to_folder`, `create_test_case_folder`
- **Bulk Operations** (18): `bulk_set_test_case_status`, `bulk_add_test_case_tags`, `bulk_remove_test_case_tags`, `bulk_clone_test_cases`, `bulk_mute_test_cases`, `bulk_delete_test_cases`, `bulk_move_test_cases`, `bulk_set_test_case_layer`, `bulk_add_test_case_members`, `bulk_remove_test_case_members`, `bulk_add_test_case_custom_fields`, `bulk_remove_test_case_custom_fields`, `bulk_add_test_case_external_links`, `bulk_add_test_case_issues`, `bulk_remove_test_case_issues`, `bulk_run_test_cases_new_launch`, `bulk_run_test_cases_existing_launch`, `bulk_create_test_plan`
- **Projects** (3): `list_projects`, `get_project`, `get_project_stats`
- **Analytics** (3): `get_launch_trend_analytics`, `get_launch_duration_analytics`, `get_test_success_rate`
- **Relations** (6): `get_test_case_relations`, `add_test_case_relation`, `remove_test_case_relation`, `get_relation_types`, `bulk_assign_test_results`, `bulk_mute_test_results`, `bulk_unmute_test_results`, `bulk_resolve_test_results`
- **Tasks** (3): `get_task_status`, `list_running_tasks`, `cancel_task` — track async background operations
- **Analysis** (1): `analyze_launch_failures` — AI-powered failure root-cause analysis via sampling

## MCP Prompts (2 templates)

| Name | Description | Arguments |
|------|-------------|-----------|
| `analyze-test-failures` | Analyze failed/broken tests in a launch: group by error, surface patterns, suggest next steps | `launch_id` (required), `project_id` (optional) |
| `launch-report-summary` | Generate an executive summary: pass rate, counts, duration, environment, top 3 failures | `launch_id` (required), `project_id` (optional) |

Prompts are returned via `prompts/list` and `prompts/get` JSON-RPC methods.

## MCP Resources

| URI | Name | MIME type | Notes |
|-----|------|-----------|-------|
| `allure://docs/quickstart` | TestOps MCP Quickstart | `text/markdown` | Always available; lists tools, prompts, setup steps |
| `ui://widgets/launch-dashboard` | Launch Dashboard | `text/html;profile=mcp-app` | Interactive widget (requires Allure token) |
| `ui://widgets/action-picker` | Action Picker | `text/html;profile=mcp-app` | Search/select from 600+ API ops |
| `ui://widgets/results-display` | Results Display | `text/html;profile=mcp-app` | JSON result viewer |

## Configuration (Environment Variables)

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `ALLURE_BASE_URL` | Yes | — | Allure TestOps instance URL (https://...) |
| `ALLURE_TOKEN` | No | — | Default API token; optional for per-user deployments |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | No | 30 | HTTP timeout in seconds (1–600) |
| `PORT` | No | 3000 | HTTP server port (HTTP mode only) |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | No | INFO | DEBUG / INFO / WARN / ERROR |
| `MCP_AUTH_TOKENS` | No | — | Named user tokens: `alice:tok1,bob:tok2` (preferred) |
| `MCP_AUTH_TOKEN` | No | — | Single legacy token; treated as user `"default"` |
| `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGIN` | No | — (disabled) | CORS origin header value |
| `AUDIT_LOG_PATH` | No | `audit` | Directory for daily audit JSONL files |
| `AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` | No | 30 | Days to keep audit files before auto-deletion |

## Deployment

**Docker (recommended — no clone required):**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/MimoJanra/TestOpsMCP:latest
docker run -e ALLURE_BASE_URL=https://your-testops.com -e ALLURE_TOKEN=... \
  -e MCP_AUTH_TOKENS=alice:tok1,bob:tok2 -p 3000:3000 \
  ghcr.io/MimoJanra/TestOpsMCP:latest --http
```
Multi-arch image: linux/amd64, linux/arm64. Pin versions: `ghcr.io/MimoJanra/TestOpsMCP:v2.0.3`

**Stdio (per-user, Claude Desktop):**
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "testops": {
      "command": "testops-mcp-windows-amd64.exe",
      "env": { "ALLURE_BASE_URL": "https://your-testops.com", "ALLURE_TOKEN": "..." }
    }
  }
}
```

**HTTP (shared team server) — Claude Desktop config via mcp-remote:**
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "testops": {
      "command": "cmd",
      "args": ["/c","npx","-y","mcp-remote","https://your-server/mcp",
               "--header","Authorization:Bearer <named-token>",
               "--header","X-Allure-Token:<allure-token>"]
    }
  }
}
```
macOS/Linux: `"command": "npx", "args": ["-y","mcp-remote",...]`

- Endpoints: `GET /health` (no auth, liveness probe), `POST /mcp` (streamable), `GET /sse` + `POST /messages` (legacy SSE)
- Named user auth via `MCP_AUTH_TOKENS=alice:tok1,bob:tok2` on the server
- All requests logged to daily JSONL audit files under `AUDIT_LOG_PATH`
